assertions.name: A6_nature_is_asymmetric_beyond_the_models_cap
assertions.source: experimental ratio 33.7055 vs model cap 1; robust 67.4..16.9

description: Runs escape (b) named by qou-v3u2: grade the two-nucleon bond by (T,S) rather than flavour. The identification is forced by Pauli — 1S0 needs symmetric isospin (T=1), 3S1 needs antisymmetric (T=0) — and the two-strand Hecke algebra has exactly two one-dimensional Wedderburn blocks, symmetric (2) and antisymmetric (1,1), with eigenvalues +q and -1/q verified against build_seminormal_matrices. RESULT: at beta = 0, a pure sigma crossing carrying NO flavour information, |mu| = q = 1.10998 > 1 in the T=1 block (unbound: pp, nn and the np singlet) and |mu| = 1/q = 0.90092 < 1 in the T=0 block (bound: the deuteron). That is exactly the physical pattern, which qou-v3u2 proved a flavour-assigned offset cannot produce at all. The window is beta in [0, 1/(q+1)) = [0, 0.473938459933) in closed form, with complementary thresholds q/(q+1) + 1/(q+1) = 1 exactly; 1/(q+1) < 1/2 for every q > 1 so the unoriented average is always outside, and production's beta_pn = 0.499656 misses by 0.025718. THE LIMIT: the achievable asymmetry between the bound and unbound channels, |L(T=0)|/|L(T=1)|, is capped at exactly 1 and attained only at beta = 0, where both channels equal log q precisely — the one point with both signs right is the point of exact mirror symmetry. Nature's ratio is 2.224566/0.066 = 33.7, robust to the virtual-state energy (17 to 67 at half/double). So escape (b) is necessary and not sufficient: it removes an impossibility and replaces it with a forced degeneracy.
caveats: 'BOUND' IS READ AS |mu| < 1. The antisymmetric block's eigenvalue is NEGATIVE (-1/q), so the ratio there is negative and -log(mu) is undefined; the magnitude is used instead. That is defensible because the sign is fixed by WHICH Hecke eigenvalue the block carries (+q vs -1/q) and is not an energy sign — but it IS a convention, it is doing real work in this result, and it should be stated wherever the result is quoted. Under a convention that treats a negative ratio as unphysical rather than as a magnitude, the T=0 channel has no binding reading at all and this escape does not run.

THIS IS AT THE n=2 INTERFACE, NOT THE FULL CONSTRUCTION. It treats each nucleon as one strand, where the corpus's atom words give each nucleon three. The survey position is that the n=2 interface version stands (mu+/mu- ARE the n=2 Wedderburn weights) while the H_6-level conjugation argument does not. Lifting the (T,S) grading into the 3-strands-per-nucleon construction is NOT done here and is where this would have to be tested next.

NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT — do not read this as the nuclear sector being fixed. It removes the impossibility proved in qou-v3u2 and replaces it with a forced degeneracy: the model cannot make the bound channel more than equally strong to the unbound one, where nature is 33.7x asymmetric. No magnitude is claimed; alpha log q = 0.4368 MeV is 5.09x low against the deuteron and 6.62x high against the 1S0 virtual state, being the same number for both.

The np 1S0 virtual-state energy ~66 keV is the least certain input here and is quoted approximately. The conclusion is shown robust to it: at half or double that value the experimental ratio is 17 or 67, both far outside the model's achievable [0, 1].
